items.title: Pay invoice for leaf removal and gutter cleaning
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie innerhalb von 10 Tagen nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung.
items.computation: The invoice sets a 10-day payment period running from 'Erhalt dieser Rechnung' (receipt of this invoice), not from a printed invoice date. The invoice itself carries no printed date anywhere on the page, and the person has not stated when it actually arrived. Because the sender is a private company (no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies, unlike letters from authorities), and because neither the issue date nor the actual receipt date is known, the start of the 10-day period cannot be fixed, so the exact due date cannot be computed. If, for illustration, the invoice were received on today's date (2026-11-24), the 10 calendar days (§§ 187(1), 188(1) BGB, counting from the day after receipt) would run out on 2026-12-04, a Friday with no shift needed — but this is only a placeholder assuming today's receipt, not a verified date.

warnings: The invoice has no printed date (no Rechnungsdatum anywhere on the page), and its 10-day payment term runs from receipt ('nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung'), so the exact due date cannot be determined without knowing when it actually arrived — please check the envelope or email it came in for a postmark or send date.

The IBAN (DE78 3705 0198 0005 5141 40) is well-formed and belongs to a German bank, matching the sender's German address, but a valid IBAN does not prove the account belongs to this company; confirm via the phone number or website you already know if in doubt.
